Theme A Space, time and motion

IB DP Physics Theme A Space, time and motion: notes and practice questions for A.1 Kinematics, A.2 Forces and momentum, A.3 Work, energy and power, A.4 Rigid body mechanics and A.5 Galilean and special relativity.
IB DP Physics A.1 Kinematics: displacement, velocity, acceleration, motion graphs, equations of motion, free fall, projectiles, relative velocity and fluid resistance.
IB DP Physics A.2 Forces and momentum: Newton's laws, free-body diagrams, contact and field forces, momentum, impulse, collisions, explosions and circular motion.
IB DP Physics A.3 Work, energy and power: conservation of energy, work, kinetic and potential energy, power, efficiency, Sankey diagrams and energy density of fuels.

IB DP Physics A.4 Rigid body mechanics (HL): torque, rotational equilibrium, angular displacement, velocity and acceleration, moment of inertia, Newton's second law for rotation, angular momentum and its conservation, angular impulse, rotational kinetic energy and rolling.

IB DP Physics A.5 Galilean and special relativity (HL): reference frames, Galilean transformations, Einstein's postulates, Lorentz transformations, relativistic velocity addition, the space-time interval, time dilation, length contraction, simultaneity, space-time diagrams and muon decay.
Theme B The particulate nature of matter

IB DP Physics Theme B The particulate nature of matter: notes and practice questions for B.1 Thermal energy transfers, B.2 Greenhouse effect, B.3 Gas laws, B.4 Thermodynamics and B.5 Current and circuits.

IB DP Physics B.1 Thermal energy transfers: the molecular model, density, temperature and the kelvin scale, internal energy, specific heat capacity, latent heat, conduction, convection, black-body radiation, Wien's law, the Stefan–Boltzmann law and apparent brightness.

IB DP Physics B.2 Greenhouse effect: energy balance, emissivity, albedo, the solar constant and S/4, equilibrium temperature, greenhouse gases, the resonance and energy-level models, surface–atmosphere energy flows and the enhanced greenhouse effect.

IB DP Physics B.3 Gas laws: pressure, the mole and the Avogadro constant, the kinetic model of an ideal gas, Boyle's law, Charles's law and the pressure law, the ideal gas equation, P = ρv²/3, internal energy of an ideal gas, p–V diagrams and real gases.

IB DP Physics B.4 Thermodynamics (HL): the first law, work done by a gas, internal energy, isovolumetric, isobaric, isothermal and adiabatic processes, heat engines and efficiency, the Carnot cycle, the second law and entropy.

IB DP Physics B.5 Current and circuits: charge, current, potential difference, circuit symbols, resistance and resistivity, Ohm's law, ohmic and non-ohmic conductors, power, series and parallel circuits, potential dividers, thermistors and LDRs, emf and internal resistance, chemical and solar cells.
IB DP Physics Theme C Wave behaviour: notes and practice questions for C.1 Simple harmonic motion, C.2 Wave model, C.3 Wave phenomena, C.4 Standing waves and resonance and C.5 Doppler effect.
IB DP Physics C.1 Simple harmonic motion: conditions for SHM, a = −ω²x, period, mass–spring and pendulum, energy, and (HL) phase and the SHM equations.
IB DP Physics C.2 Wave model: transverse and longitudinal waves, wavelength, frequency and wave speed, wave graphs, sound and electromagnetic waves.

IB DP Physics C.3 Wave phenomena: wavefronts and rays, reflection, refraction, Snell's law, total internal reflection, diffraction, superposition, interference, Young's double slit and (HL) single-slit diffraction and gratings.
IB DP Physics C.4 Standing waves and resonance: how standing waves form, nodes and antinodes, harmonics on strings and in pipes, natural frequency, resonance and damping.

IB DP Physics C.5 Doppler effect: wavefront diagrams for moving sources and observers, the Doppler effect for light, redshift and blueshift, uses in astronomy, medicine and radar, and (HL) the Doppler equations for sound.
IB DP Physics Theme D Fields: notes and practice questions for D.1 Gravitational fields, D.2 Electric and magnetic fields, D.3 Motion in electromagnetic fields and D.4 Induction.

IB DP Physics D.1 Gravitational fields: Kepler's laws, Newton's law of gravitation, gravitational field strength, field lines, orbits and Kepler's third law; HL: gravitational potential energy and potential, potential gradient, equipotentials, escape speed, orbital speed and energy, and orbital decay.

IB DP Physics D.2 Electric and magnetic fields: charge, Millikan's experiment, charging by friction, contact and induction, Coulomb's law and permittivity, electric field strength and field lines, uniform fields between plates, magnetic field patterns; HL: electric potential energy, electric potential, potential gradient and equipotentials.

IB DP Physics D.3 Motion in electromagnetic fields: charged particles in uniform electric fields, the magnetic force F = qvB sin θ, circular motion in a magnetic field, charge-to-mass ratio, crossed fields and velocity selectors, the force on a current-carrying wire, and the force between parallel wires.

IB DP Physics D.4 Induction (HL): magnetic flux and flux linkage, Faraday's law, the emf induced in a moving conductor, Lenz's law and energy conservation, coils moving in and out of fields, ac generators and the effect of rotation frequency, and self-induction.
Theme E Nuclear and quantum physics
IB DP Physics Theme E Nuclear and quantum physics: notes and practice questions for E.1 Structure of the atom, E.2 Quantum physics, E.3 Radioactive decay, E.4 Fission and E.5 Fusion and stars.

IB DP Physics E.1 Structure of the atom: the Geiger–Marsden–Rutherford experiment, nuclear notation, emission and absorption spectra, energy levels and E = hf; HL: nuclear radius and density, closest approach, deviations from Rutherford scattering and the Bohr model of hydrogen.

IB DP Physics E.2 Quantum physics (HL): the photoelectric effect, threshold frequency, work function and Einstein's equation, why the wave model fails, electron diffraction and the de Broglie wavelength, wave–particle duality, and Compton scattering.

IB DP Physics E.3 Radioactive decay: the strong nuclear force, mass defect and binding energy, the binding energy per nucleon curve, alpha, beta and gamma decay equations, neutrinos, penetration and ionization, activity, half-life and background radiation; HL: neutron–proton ratio, nuclear energy levels, the beta spectrum, the decay constant and the exponential decay law.

IB DP Physics E.4 Fission: spontaneous and neutron-induced fission, energy released in fission, chain reactions and critical mass, the nuclear power station (moderator, control rods, coolant, heat exchanger, shielding), and fission products and nuclear waste.

IB DP Physics E.5 Fusion and stars: conditions for fusion, energy released in fusion, the equilibrium of stars, astronomical units, light years and parsecs, stellar parallax, stellar spectra, determining stellar radii, the Hertzsprung–Russell diagram and the evolution of stars of different masses.
